Done. Here's the full picture:

| Command | Works | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `bun run dev:cf` | ✅ | Builds worker, starts `wrangler dev --no-bundle --local` |
| `bun run deploy:cf` | ✅ | Builds worker, runs `wrangler deploy --no-bundle` |
| `pnpm run dev:cf` | ✅ | Same (pnpm also just executes the shell script) |

**Fully local mode** already works because:
- `wrangler.toml` has `localConnectionString = "postgres://paperclip:paperclip@127.0.0.1:54329/paperclip"` — used automatically in `wrangler dev`
- `.dev.vars` sets `DEPLOYMENT_MODE=local_trusted` — bypasses auth
- `SIDECAR_SERVICE`/`PLUGIN_CONTAINER` DO stubs fall back to the external bridge URL from KV (or `.dev.vars` `SIDECAR_URL`) when `this.ctx.container` is absent locally
